outcome: preference for cesarean section in subsequent pregnancy
factors predicting choice of delivery mode after OASI
cohort: 153 patients who had suffered an OASI
finding: The study found that endoanal ultrasound results and ethnicity are strong predictors of a woman's choice of delivery mode after experiencing an OASI.
mod_finding: Approximately 30% of patients who sustained an obstetric anal sphincter injury preferred to have a cesarean section in their subsequent pregnancy.
